item.title: California Democrats have new plans for confronting ICE: Taxes, lawsuits and location bans
item.description: The California Senate passed a bill that would make it easier to sue federal officers over civil rights violations. Recent shootings of civilians by immigration agents in Minnesota lent urgency to the measure, one of several targeting ICE. The post California Democrats have new plans for confronting ICE: Taxes, lawsuits and location bans appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: New CSULB president selected, will start in May
item.description: Loren J. Blanchard, the current president of the University of Houston-Downtown, will succeed Andrew Jones, who served as acting president after Jane Close Conoley retired last summer. The post New CSULB president selected, will start in May appeared first on Long Beach Post.
